services:
  openldap:
    image: ghcr.io/ldapjs/docker-test-openldap/openldap:2023-10-30
    ports:
      - 389:389
      - 636:636
    healthcheck:
      start_period: 3s
      test: >
        /usr/bin/ldapsearch -Y EXTERNAL -Q -H ldapi:// -b ou=people,dc=planetexpress,dc=com -LLL '(cn=Turanga Leela)' cn 1>/dev/null

{
  "originalAuthor": "Mark Cavage <mcavage@gmail.com>",
  "name": "@infisical/ldapjs",
  "types": "types/index.d.ts",
  "homepage": "http://ldapjs.org",
  "description": "LDAP client and server APIs",
  "version": "3.0.11",
  "license": "MIT",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git://github.com/Infisical/node-ldapjs.git"
  },
  "main": "lib/index.js",
  "files": [
    "lib/",
    "types/"
  ],
  "dependencies": {
    "@ldapjs/asn1": "^2.0.0",
    "@ldapjs/attribute": "^1.0.0",
    "@ldapjs/change": "^1.0.0",
    "@ldapjs/controls": "^2.1.0",
    "@ldapjs/dn": "^1.1.0",
    "@ldapjs/filter": "^2.1.1",
    "@ldapjs/messages": "^1.3.0",
    "@ldapjs/protocol": "^1.2.1",
    "abstract-logging": "^2.0.1",
    "assert-plus": "^1.0.0",
    "backoff": "^2.5.0",
    "once": "^1.4.0",
    "vasync": "^2.2.1",
    "verror": "^1.10.1"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/ldapjs": "^3.0.6",
    "@fastify/pre-commit": "^2.0.2",
    "eslint": "^8.44.0",
    "eslint-config-standard": "^17.0.0",
    "eslint-plugin-import": "^2.27.5",
    "eslint-plugin-n": "^16.0.0",
    "eslint-plugin-node": "^11.1.0",
    "eslint-plugin-promise": "6.1.1",
    "front-matter": "^4.0.2",
    "get-port": "^5.1.1",
    "highlight.js": "^11.7.0",
    "marked": "^4.2.12",
    "tap": "^16.3.7"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "test": "tap --no-cov -R terse",
    "test:ci": "tap --coverage-report=lcovonly -R terse",
    "test:cov": "tap -R terse",
    "test:cov:html": "tap --coverage-report=html -R terse",
    "test:watch": "tap -n -w --no-coverage-report -R terse",
    "test:integration": "tap --no-cov -R terse 'test-integration/**/*.test.js'",
    "test:integration:local": "docker-compose up -d --wait && npm run test:integration ; docker-compose down",
    "lint": "eslint . --fix",
    "lint:ci": "eslint .",
    "docs": "node scripts/build-docs.js"
  },
  "pre-commit": [
    "lint:ci",
    "test"
  ],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public"
  }
}

# node-ldapjs fork

This is a fork of the v3.0.7 release of the [node-ldapjs](https://github.com/ldapjs/node-ldapjs) repository.
